|translation='''Title:''' Leia.

'''Lore:''' Adopted daughter of Alderaan's governor and first chairman. She became a political leader at a young age. She joined the Rebellion in opposition to the cruelty of the Emperor's edicts.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore refers to the cruelty of the Emperor's edicts.

'''Game text:''' None printed.
|notes='''Leia (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Leia (Jedi Pack)|Leia]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Leia (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R63 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R63.
